mentions.name: pta-standards
mentions.description: Formal specifications for plain text accounting formats covering Beancount, Ledger, and hledger. It includes EBNF/ABNF grammars, JSON Schema and Protobuf AST definitions, tree-sitter grammars, Alloy models for invariants, and conformance test suites, so anyone can build a correct, interoperable PTA implementation without reverse-engineering existing tools.
mentions.problem: Building a correct, interoperable plain text accounting implementation currently requires reverse-engineering existing tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started this project to create proper formal specifications for plain text accounting formats, covering Beancount, Ledger, and hledger. It includes EBNF/ABNF grammars, JSON Schema and Protobuf AST definitions, tree-sitter grammars, Alloy models for invariants, and conformance test suites. The idea is to make it possible for anyone to build a correct, interoperable PTA implementation without reverse-engineering existing tools.
